user.title: Open-Meteo
user.description: Choose how the weather location is determined. Location tracking follows the selected person or device without changing Open-Meteo entity identity.

static_source.title: Static location
static_source.description: Choose how to set the fixed weather location. The selected coordinates are saved once and are not tracked afterwards.

static_entity.title: Use current position
static_entity.description: Choose a person or device. Its current GPS coordinates will be copied once as the fixed weather location.

static_search.title: Search for a place
static_search.description: Enter a city, town, village or address.

details.title: Weather source setup
details.description: Confirm the location, update frequency and sensors.

data_description.entity_id: Select a person or device that provides GPS coordinates.
data_description.min_track_interval: Small position changes are grouped. Large location changes are accepted immediately.
data_description.area_name_override: Leave empty to display the current place automatically.
data_description.reverse_geocode_cooldown_min: Limits how often the place name is resolved for small position changes.

error.invalid_entity: The selected person or device does not expose GPS coordinates
error.location_not_found: No matching place or address was found
